title: Tiny, cute paint palette
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- palette body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='36' ry='28' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- lighter highlight on palette -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='21' fill='#E0A95C'/>
  <!-- thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#8B5E2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#B87A36'/>
  <!-- paint blobs -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='6' fill='#FF3B3B'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='40' r='3' fill='#FF8080'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='34' r='6' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='34' r='3' fill='#FFF59A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='6' fill='#3BFF6A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='3' fill='#9BFFB8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='42' r='6' fill='#3B8BFF'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='42' r='3' fill='#9BC8FF'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='6' fill='#C23BFF'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='3' fill='#E39BFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='56' r='5' fill='#FF8C00'/>

  <!-- paintbrush -->
  <rect x='70' y='58' width='4' height='24' rx='2' fill='#D4A24E' transform='rotate(20 72 70)'/>
  <rect x='69' y='54' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#B0B0B0' transform='rotate(20 72 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#FF3B3B' transform='rotate(20 70 52)'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M84 20 L86 26 L92 28 L86 30 L84 36 L82 30 L76 28 L82 26 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
